test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Restrain
solution:
The correct option is **"Constrain"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The definition of a **synonym** is one of two or more words or expressions that share a common denominator and are semantically equivalent in certain senses or nearly so.
 
• To **restrain** implies preventing or regulating to do something.
 
 
• ***Example:** Ram was talking to me without **restraint**.*
 
 
 
• The absolute meaning of **"Restrain"** is **Constrain** which means restrictions from doing something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine what other choices mean.
 
• **To give permission** to someone is to **allow** him or her which does not make any sense with restrain.
 
• **Assist** means to provide further help or assistance.
 
• **Free** refers to being **unrestrained** or unencumbered.
 
• The other three choices don't fit with the word **restrain**.
